verses.text: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear.

xrefs.text: “Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!

Why was no one there when I arrived? Why did no one answer when I called? Is My hand too short to redeem you? Or do I lack the strength to deliver you? Behold, My rebuke dries up the sea; I turn the rivers into a desert; the fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.
The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you— in about a year — and Sarah will have a son.”

verses.text: But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He does not hear.

xrefs.text: The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
Your iniquities have diverted these from you; your sins have deprived you of My bounty.
Then they will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.
When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.

On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them. On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’

verses.text: For your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters injustice.

xrefs.text: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have uttered vain words and seen false visions, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.
Moreover, your skirts are stained with the blood of the innocent poor, though you did not find them breaking in. But in spite of all these things
“I have struck your sons in vain; they accepted no discipline. Your own sword has devoured your prophets like a voracious lion.”
See how the faithful city has become a harlot! She once was full of justice; righteousness resided within her, but now only murderers!

verses.text: No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

xrefs.text: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.”
The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
Do not trust in deceptive words, saying: ‘This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD.’
But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.

verses.text: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die; crack one open, and a viper is hatched.

xrefs.text: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken. For a viper will spring from the root of the snake, and a flying serpent from its egg.
You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
His confidence is fragile; his security is in a spider’s web.

verses.text: Their cobwebs cannot be made into clothing, and they cannot cover themselves with their works. Their deeds are sinful deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.

xrefs.text: As a well gushes its water, so she pours out her evil. Violence and destruction resound in her; sickness and wounds are ever before Me.
I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not profit you.
You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing. But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
Your covenant with death will be dissolved, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.

verses.text: Their feet run to evil; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are sinful thoughts; ruin and destruction lie in their wake.

xrefs.text: “Their feet are swift to shed blood;
haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
For their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.
For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
“But your eyes and heart are set on nothing except your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.”

verses.text: The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.

xrefs.text: But the wicked are like the storm-tossed sea, for it cannot be still, and its waves churn up mire and muck.
and the way of peace they have not known.”
to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David. Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?

For the vineyard of the LORD of Hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are the plant of His delight. He looked for justice, but saw bloodshed; for righteousness, but heard a cry of distress.

verses.text: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We hope for light, but there is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in gloom.

xrefs.text: In that day they will roar over it, like the roaring of the sea. If one looks over the land, he will see darkness and distress; even the light will be obscured by clouds.
But when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, darkness fell.

Have You rejected Judah completely? Do You despise Zion? Why have You stricken us so that we are beyond healing? We hoped for peace, but no good has come, and for the time of healing, but there was only terror.
While people are saying, “Peace and security, destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
We hoped for peace, but no good has come, for a time of healing, but there was only terror.

verses.text: Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.

xrefs.text: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.
They encounter darkness by day and grope at noon as in the night.
He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
And in that day, declares the Lord GOD, I will make the sun go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the daytime.
But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they do not know what makes them stumble.

verses.text: We all growl like bears and moan like doves. We hope for justice, but find none, for salvation, but it is far from us.

xrefs.text: I chirp like a swallow or crane; I moan like a dove. My eyes grow weak as I look upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; be my security.”
The survivors will escape and live in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valley, each for his own iniquity.
I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
Oh, that my head were a spring of water, and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night over the slain daughter of my people.

verses.text: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:

xrefs.text: and said: “O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.
Although our iniquities testify against us, O LORD, act for the sake of Your name. Indeed, our rebellions are many; we have sinned against You.
Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; even Judah stumbles with them.

But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her. For her people have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.’
Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.

verses.text: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.

xrefs.text: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
If only I had a traveler’s lodge in the wilderness, I would abandon my people and depart from them, for they are all adulterers, a crowd of faithless people.
Yet in spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to Me with all her heart, but only in pretense,” declares the LORD.

verses.text: So justice is turned away, and righteousness stands at a distance. For truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.

xrefs.text: Furthermore, I saw under the sun that in the place of judgment there is wickedness, and in the place of righteousness there is wickedness.
Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
Woe to those who enact unjust statutes and issue oppressive decrees,

Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.
Like cages full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit. Therefore they have become powerful and rich.

verses.text: Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.

xrefs.text: The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
Therefore you must say to them, ‘This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the LORD their God and would not receive correction. Truth has perished; it has disappeared from their lips.
Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.

verses.text: He saw that there was no man; He was amazed that there was no one to intercede. So His own arm brought salvation, and His own righteousness sustained Him.

xrefs.text: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so that I should not destroy it. But I found no one.
So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity.

“I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me. I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury; their blood spattered My garments, and all My clothes were stained.

verses.text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.

xrefs.text: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
The night is nearly over; the day has drawn near. So let us lay aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
Righteousness will be the belt around His hips, and faithfulness the sash around His waist.

verses.text: So He will repay according to their deeds: fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, and recompense to the islands.

xrefs.text: I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
I trampled the nations in My anger; in My wrath I made them drunk and poured out their blood on the ground.”
For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
God “will repay each one according to his deeds.”
The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.

verses.text: So shall they fear the name of the LORD where the sun sets, and His glory where it rises. For He will come like a raging flood, driven by the breath of the LORD.

xrefs.text: Then the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people, the saints of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will serve and obey Him.’
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.

verses.text: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression, declares the LORD.

xrefs.text: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and turn from all your transgressions, so that your iniquity will not become your downfall.
Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

verses.text: “As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.

xrefs.text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
“This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols.
They will be My people, and I will be their God.
Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.
